name: damage_lethal_death
about: Lethal damage on a live idle Troika human (lifecycle.md 'The death chain, kill to corpse'). The scalar TakeDamage input past the NPC's health: CBaseCombatCharacter::OnTakeDamage 0x1032ef60 dispatches slot 144 at the threshold. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::Event_Killed 0x102bf340 -> CAI_BaseNPC::Event_Killed 0x10265ad0: DeathSound (slot 488), m_OnDeath fired (0x10265a90, activator the attacker), BecomeDead, then CBaseCombatCharacter::Event_Killed 0x1032b9b0 -> slot 301 CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0 (BecomeClientRagdoll 0x10090180 for an ordinary NPC: the dying NPC itself becomes the corpse, seeded from its pose and handed to physics; SUB_PVSRemove at +10 s), m_IdealNPCState = 7, SetState(7). The corpse lies on the floor. After it the only programs base SelectSchedule 0x1028a380 can answer in state 7 are 0x2c SCHED_DIE_RAGDOLL / 0x2b DIE (0x1028a8ec); no Troika program is ever installed again.
known_red: 3: a dead NPC stays standing (the corpse is not landed)
